UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user cycle preferences and profile metadata isolated per authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

defaultCycleLength.description: Baseline average cycle length in days (15 to 60).

defaultPeriodDuration.description: Baseline average period duration in days (1 to 15).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PeriodLog.title: PeriodLog
PeriodLog.description: A single menstrual period log entry with start date and optional end date.

user_id.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this period log.

start_date.description: First day of the logged period in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Last day of the logged period in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when ongoing.

created_at.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updated_at.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user preferences and cycle defaults keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/period_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user menstrual period logs ordered by start_date.
